Lemma
[Characterization of the King--Rosenau solution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0095 1. ch29:29.3\group King–Rosenau Solution

Suppose an ancient solution has pressure $v(\psi ,t)=\alpha (t)+\beta (t)\cos ^2\psi $, where $\alpha ,\beta >0$ and $\alpha (t)\to \infty $ as $t\nearrow 0$. Then, for some $\mu >0$, \[ \alpha (t)=-\mu \operatorname {csch}(4\mu t),\qquad \beta (t)=-\mu \tanh (2\mu t), \] and the solution is the King--Rosenau solution.
